polaris: Decide whether eta/P_oe is an independent input-side phase-bus residual or only missing baseline structure/noise under nickelate constraints.
framework: Measurement-invariance and error-in-variables identifiability, borrowed from econometrics and metrology: a residual is independent only if it is stable under baseline-matched interventions and not annihilated by expanding the calibration baseline.
findings: B cannot honestly prove a universal no-go for every imaginable eta without assuming normal-state response closure. The strongest defensible result is conditional. If all admissible input-side measurements are normal-state linear-response or spectroscopy kernels, and the baseline is expanded to include the full probe kernel components that generate odd/even susceptibility contrast, then eta is baseline-generated and I(C_phi;Z_pre|B_plus)=0. Without that closure, the result downgrades to empirical non-identifiability: current nickelate sample counts, oxygen/strain/pressure covariance, and incomplete layer-resolved baselines make P_oe indistinguishable from missing baseline structure unless a matched intervention produces a residual above a pre-registered threshold.

math_object.name: Eta decomposition and baseline-closure criterion
math_object.eta_decomposition: eta = U_miss + epsilon_meas + R_oe, where U_miss is unmeasured oxygen/strain/orbital/dephasing/pressure/sample-quality structure, epsilon_meas is finite-resolution and batch noise, and R_oe is the only possible independent odd/even phase-transfer residual.
math_object.expanded_baseline: B_plus = (W_D,c, gamma_c, rho_c/rho_ab, W_dz2, W_RE5d, n_self_doping, V_O(r,z), O_apical(r,z), layer_asymmetry, epsilon_strain(r,z), interface_capping, thickness, pressure_path, disorder_length, Delta_bilayer(k), M_even/odd(k,q,omega), Sigma_even/odd(k,omega), Gamma_vertex_even/odd).
math_object.closure_claim: Under normal-state response closure, chi_even and chi_odd are generated by B_plus through the susceptibility kernel, so P_oe=(chi_odd-chi_even)/(chi_odd+chi_even)=H(B_plus)+epsilon_meas and any C_phi=f(P_oe,other input probes) is B_plus-measurable up to measurement noise.
math_object.downgraded_claim: If B_plus is not measured or the response closure is not accepted, B should not claim a theorem. The correct status is empirical non-identifiability under present nickelate constraints.

eta_classification.epsilon_meas: Baseline-generated noise when P_oe variation is below propagated uncertainty from RIXS/Raman/neutron/THz/optical matrix elements, normalization, temperature drift, pressure drift, and batch alignment.
eta_classification.U_miss: Missing baseline when P_oe covaries with residual/apical oxygen, layer asymmetry, strain gradients, dz2/RE5d/self-doping, pressure path, dephasing, or bilayer splitting after those are measured with higher resolution.
eta_classification.R_oe: A genuine independent residual only if the same sign and magnitude of Delta P_oe remains across baseline-matched replicate pairs and survives negative-control baselines that should not contain phase-bus information.
eta_classification.B_round2_position: For nickelates, eta should be treated as U_miss plus epsilon_meas until R_oe clears the residual threshold below. That is a downgrade from universal no-go to empirical non-identifiability, not a proof of nonexistence.

assumptions_for_conditional_mutual_infor.statement: I(C_phi;Z_pre|B_plus)=0 is valid only under explicit assumptions, and Z_pre must be a pre-output readiness label or future input-side state descriptor, not Tc, zero resistance, Meissner response, critical current, gap opening, or any superconducting output.
assumptions: A1: C_phi is constructed only from input-side normal-state probes, structural diagnostics, synthesis metadata, and pressure/strain metadata.
A2: The expanded baseline B_plus contains the common causes and probe-kernel terms that generate chi_even, chi_odd, c-axis coherence, orbital weight, dephasing, and layer asymmetry.
A3: epsilon_meas is independent of Z_pre conditional on B_plus and has zero mean after calibration.
A4: Any structured component of eta reproducible across batches is either included in B_plus or explicitly declared R_oe and tested as a residual.
A5: Z_pre is not used to construct C_phi and is not a disguised output variable.
A6: The sample-selection process does not condition on hidden superconducting outcomes.
assumptions_for_conditional_mutual_infor.consequence: With A1-A6, C_phi=h(B_plus,epsilon_meas), so the only nonzero conditional information can come from measurement noise or an omitted structured residual. If epsilon_meas is conditionally independent and R_oe is absent, I(C_phi;Z_pre|B_plus)=0.

kubo_argument.status: Downgraded from universal Kubo no-go to closure-dependent reduction.
kubo_argument.schematic_expression: chi_alpha(q,omega) = sum_k |M_alpha(k,q)|^2 [f(E_k)-f(E_{k+q})] / [omega + E_k - E_{k+q} + i Gamma_alpha(k,q,omega)] plus vertex/self-energy corrections, alpha in {even,odd}.
kubo_argument.reduction: P_oe is generated by differences in M_even/odd, bilayer splitting, orbital weights, self-energy, vertex corrections, and dephasing. In nickelates those terms are controlled by interlayer hopping, dz2/RE5d/self-doping, oxygen fields, strain/interface asymmetry, pressure history, and disorder. Therefore P_oe is not automatically independent; it is a normal-state susceptibility contrast unless a residual survives after these kernel terms are measured.
limits: If chi_odd + chi_even approaches zero, P_oe is ill-conditioned and must be excluded or regularized with a denominator floor.
If gamma_even and gamma_odd dominate over bilayer splitting, P_oe becomes a dephasing/disorder proxy.
If layer asymmetry or oxygen gradients dominate M_odd/M_even, P_oe becomes a structural/sample-quality proxy.
If a sign-stable P_oe residual remains after B_plus matching, Kubo closure is incomplete and B is falsified.

cross_disciplinary_structure.source: Metrology gauge R&R plus econometric negative controls.
cross_disciplinary_structure.usefulness: The borrowed structure sharpens identifiability: separate repeatability noise, reproducibility/batch noise, missing confounders, and a true residual; then require the residual to survive matched pairs and negative controls.
cross_disciplinary_structure.translation: P_oe is not accepted as a new variable because a fit coefficient is nonzero. It must be a reproducible gauge-invariant residual after baseline calibration.

landing_design.system: La3Ni2O7-delta or closely related bilayer nickelate platelets/films measured in the normal state under a fixed pressure window, with an optional infinite-layer control set only for calibration of oxygen/disorder baselines.
landing_design.sample_plan: Minimum 12 matched specimens: 6 matched pairs across two synthesis batches. Each pair must be matched before P_oe ranking is opened. No superconducting output variables are used for selection, ranking, fitting, or stopping.
landing_design.temperature_pressure_window: Normal-state measurements at T >= 1.5 times any known sample-specific transition scale if known from external literature, otherwise fixed T = 80 K and 120 K; pressure held within +/-0.2 GPa during a run and pressure path recorded as load/unload history.
baseline_vector: W_D,c and low-frequency c-axis spectral weight from optical/THz conductivity
gamma_c or dephasing rate from optical linewidth/transport/NMR normal-state linewidth
V_O(r,z) and O_apical(r,z) from STEM-EELS/ptychography or equivalent depth-resolved oxygen map
epsilon_strain(r,z), thickness, interface/capping state, and mosaicity
W_dz2, W_RE5d, and self-doping proxies from XAS/ARPES/RIXS where feasible
Delta_bilayer(k) or a proxy for bilayer splitting/interlayer hopping

matching_tolerances.oxygen_vacancy_density: +/-0.01 oxygen per formula unit or instrument-equivalent 1 sigma map uncertainty
matching_tolerances.residual_apical_oxygen: +/-0.005 oxygen per formula unit where resolvable
matching_tolerances.strain: +/-0.15 percent mean in-plane strain and no unmatched gradient above 0.05 percent per layer
matching_tolerances.thickness: +/-1 unit cell for films or +/-5 percent for platelets
matching_tolerances.dz2_RE5d_weight: +/-5 percent integrated spectral weight after normalization

landing_design.measurement_error_model: Use hierarchical errors: within-run repeatability, between-day reproducibility, and between-batch random effect. Propagate baseline uncertainties into sigma_res(P_oe) by bootstrap or Bayesian errors-in-variables regression.
landing_design.residual_definition: r_i = P_oe,i - E[P_oe,i | B_plus,i]. The decision statistic is Delta r_pair for matched pairs and the partial R2 of r for any pre-output Z_pre.
landing_design.B_pass_threshold: B survives if |Delta r_pair| <= 2 sigma_res for at least 5 of 6 pairs and the cross-validated partial R2 added by r is < 0.05 with 95 percent bootstrap CI including 0.
landing_design.B_fail_threshold: B is falsified if at least 4 of 6 matched pairs show the same-sign |Delta r_pair| >= 3 sigma_res, the pooled residual shift is >= 0.10 in normalized P_oe units, and the cross-validated partial R2 added by r is >= 0.10 with 95 percent bootstrap CI excluding 0.
negative_controls: Swap batch labels and require residual signal to disappear.
Use a structural channel with no odd/even selection sensitivity as a placebo residual.
Repeat P_oe extraction with two probe windows; a genuine residual must retain sign after matrix-element recalibration.

strangest_prediction: If eta is baseline-generated, the apparent odd/even residual will track whichever baseline is least resolved. In practice, adding depth-resolved oxygen/layer-asymmetry maps or dz2/RE5d spectral weight should flip a previously significant P_oe residual into noise more often than it creates a new stable residual.
a_objection: A will say that including M_even/odd, Sigma_even/odd, and Gamma_vertex_even/odd in B_plus absorbs the thing being tested. B response: yes, that is why the universal theorem is conditional. The empirical question is whether experimentally accessible lower-dimensional baselines already annihilate P_oe within error. If not, B loses the practical no-go even if the formal closure remains true.
failed_jumps: Topology: no protected invariant was identified that would make P_oe immune to oxygen/strain/dephasing baselines.
Neuroscience predictive coding: useful only as a noise-versus-signal decomposition; it did not provide a nickelate-specific independent variable.
Linguistic deep/surface structure: mapped to hidden baseline versus measured proxy, but gave no additional physics beyond identifiability.
next_plan: Round 3 B should turn the landing design into a go/no-go table: exact accepted probes, denominator floor for P_oe, exclusion rules for ill-conditioned chi_odd+chi_even, and a minimal baseline set B_min that is experimentally realistic rather than tautological.

claims.statement: The eta gap cannot be closed as a universal no-go without a normal-state response-closure assumption.
equations: universal collapse requires R_oe = 0 or R_oe in sigma(B_plus)
assumptions: B does not read current-CphiCollapse/A or A outputs.
No superconducting output variables are used.
Eta may contain structured residual unless explicitly tested.

claims.statement: Under expanded normal-state kernel closure, P_oe is baseline-generated rather than independent.
assumptions: The susceptibility kernels are normal-state kernels.
B_plus includes matrix elements, self-energy, vertex, dephasing, orbital, oxygen, strain, and pressure-history terms.
The denominator chi_odd+chi_even is not near the noise floor.

claims.statement: Without full B_plus measurement, the correct B conclusion is empirical non-identifiability under nickelate constraints.
equations: B survives if |Delta r_pair|<=2 sigma_res and partial R2(r)<0.05
B fails if same-sign |Delta r_pair|>=3 sigma_res in >=4/6 matched pairs and partial R2(r)>=0.10
assumptions: Realistic nickelate datasets remain small and synthesis variables are correlated.
Matched-pair intervention is stronger than observational residual regression.

claims.statement: The most likely annihilator of eta/P_oe is not generic c-axis Drude weight alone, but the combined layer-resolved oxygen/asymmetry plus dz2/RE5d/self-doping plus odd/even dephasing baseline.
assumptions: Odd/even contrast is sensitive to layer asymmetry and orbital matrix elements.
Probe-specific matrix elements are calibrated rather than ignored.
Pressure path is treated as a baseline, not metadata.

formula: I(C_phi;Z_pre|B_plus)=0 only if C_phi is B_plus-measurable up to conditionally independent epsilon_meas and Z_pre is pre-output
inspector_check.direction: B downgrades universal no-go to empirical non-identifiability unless normal-state response closure is assumed.
inspector_check.data: No new raw data used; this round uses Round 1 synthesis, B Round 1 inspector warnings, and input-side nickelate constraint logic.
